resource: Out-of-combat LivenessProbe cadence of one admitted positioned connection
allocation_impact: One outstanding probe per connection; one probe frame per cadence tick; no per-probe allocation beyond one frame.
boundary_tests: 5000 ms: a probe is sent one cadence after the baseline snapshot and then every cadence
An answered probe resets the missed count; a late ack of an older probe restores nothing
notes: Provisional owner value, DISCONNECT-PROTECTION-V1 (#822 comments 5854525644 and 5854565314); to be measured and tuned (latency/jitter false-positive rate, combat tick) before release. FND-02 authenticated probe/ack only; socket close, gameplay silence or client report never prove loss. Out-of-combat loss is declared three cadences after the first unanswered probe (four after the baseline snapshot).
